extracted.name: Banana muffins with chocolate
extracted.description: Our favourite muffins. Kids love them. The recipe is for 24 muffins.
instruction_lines: Mix egg and crystal sugar then add other ingredients except bananas and chocolate and mix it together.
Cut chocolate to how big pieces you would like and mash bananas and add it to the mix.
Fill cups to 3/4 and bake 220C for 15-20 minutes
